_about: One entry per package whose metadata the gate cannot classify (UNKNOWN, missing, SEE LICENSE IN ...) or whose copyleft reading was reviewed and found wrong.
Fields: package, licence (the licence actually verified, from the package's LICENSE file, with the URL), reason, acceptedOn (YYYY-MM-DD), acceptedBy.
An exception is never a way past a real AGPL/GPL/SSPL dependency: the gate reports an unused exception as stale and fails, so entries leave with the package.
